title: Raise default_statistics_target to 300 for GetUserTweets selectivity
configuration_cause: default_statistics_target=100 gives coarse MCV/histogram resolution for the skewed user_id predicate driving GetUserTweets, which consumes 88% of terminal capacity; finer estimates can reduce pages touched per call.
mechanism: GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity (0.88) with p50 171us and p99 1092us. Its predicate on user_id is skewed; at statistics target 100 the planner's MCV/histogram resolution is coarse, so estimated rows and chosen index path can be off, inflating pages per call. Raising default_statistics_target to 300 triples histogram/MCV resolution within the safe [50,500] band, sharpening selectivity estimates and letting the planner pick tighter index scans. This is a planner/statistics mechanism distinct from the refuted WAL and buffer bundles; it targets the dominant transaction's per-call cost rather than commit-path queueing.
query_effect: Finer user_id selectivity estimates should let the planner choose a tighter index path for GetUserTweets, reducing pages touched per call and lowering its p50/p95 latency.
expected_tps_effect: Modest increase in successful_transaction_tps as GetUserTweets terminal occupancy falls.
expected_latency_effect: Decrease GetUserTweets p50 and p95; other transactions largely unchanged.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Triple from 100 to 300 within safe [50,500]; 3x histogram/MCV resolution for skewed user_id while keeping ANALYZE cost bounded.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: column statistics resolution for skewed predicate selectivity

predictions.rationale: Finer selectivity estimates tighten index path, reducing pages per GetUserTweets call.
Sharper estimates reduce occasional over-scan on skewed user_id.
Lower GetUserTweets terminal occupancy frees capacity for more completed transactions.

alternatives.statement: If GetUserTweets latency is dominated by WAL/commit queueing rather than planner estimates, statistics target will not move p50 and TPS stays flat.
If user_id selectivity is already well estimated at target 100, raising to 300 yields no plan change and no latency reduction.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Targets the dominant 88%-terminal-capacity transaction's planner estimates, a mechanism not yet tested; prior WAL and buffer bundles were refuted or inconclusive, so a statistics-resolution test isolates the query-execution lever.

nodes.label: Finer user_id selectivity estimates reduce GetUserTweets pages per call

cross_domain_requirements: ANALYZE must run after target change for statistics to take effect
